# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version published on npm receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a [private advisory](https://github.com/Masmarino/Gabarit/security/advisories/new)
rather than a public issue — this avoids exposing an exploitable flaw
before a fix is available.

Include the affected component, a minimal reproduction, and the
estimated impact. A first response is targeted within 5 business days.
